reply.text:
I'm sorry you're feeling that way about how you look, and I'm glad you told me. Skipping meals all week to lose weight is something I won't build a plan around, and this is one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian. They can help you with the eating side in a way that's safe for you.

Once you've had that conversation, I'm glad to help with the training side, and we start from wherever you are. Eating regular meals is also what makes training feel better, so please don't wait on the appointment to feed yourself.
